description: Defines a LocalCache class for storing and retrieving menu data and auth tokens using SharedPreferences.

classes.name: LocalCache
classes.description: A utility class for caching menu data and authentication tokens locally using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: saveMenuJson
methods.description: Saves a menu JSON object into shared preferences under a specific key.

methods.name: getMenuJson
methods.description: Retrieves the cached menu JSON object from shared preferences.

methods.name: saveToken
methods.description: Stores an authentication token into shared preferences.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored authentication token from shared preferences.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes the stored authentication token from shared preferences.
